name: perp-funding-carry regime flip (dYdX v4 indexer, real history)
catchLine: Yield source: perp-funding carry (not lending interest) — 100% of the yield is funding-carry; funding was negative in 508 of the last 1000 periods (50.8%, venues: dydx); when it flips, this yield inverts and the peg takes the strain. Peg and yield are scored JOINTLY here — a funding flip strains the peg, so they are one risk, not two. info/context — a fact about the yield's source, never advice.
claim: HIT — the yield-source funding-flip census fired on REAL dYdX history: funding was negative in 508 of 1000 periods (50.8%) — a "savings rate" that is really short-vol carry would have inverted in those windows.
